rows.name: Grunz Grundsatz
rows.signature: very WIDE squat ink splat, three blunt crown lobes, massive underbite with ONE big lower ivory tusk and TWO tiny upper teeth, scarlet cloth headband and amber bead. No human muscles or feet.
stages: Bewildered open underbite, raised asymmetric brows. Holds a short fat rough wooden CLUB tied with one cord; tiny ragged sheepskin collar.
Furious teeth clenched sideways, sideways leaning goo. Same club now stone-headed, same headband/bead, one broad leather wristband.
Rapturous roaring underbite, one eye squeezed shut, triumphant tilted crown. Same club now chunky iron-banded, tiny bone clasp on same sheepskin collar; not oversized armour.
rows.note: Sein Berserkerrausch beginnt nach Rücksprache mit der Gruppe.

rows.name: Schwester Restgewissheit
rows.signature: tall narrow bent pear ink blob, two drooping side lobes, asymmetrical small ivory fangs, soft burgundy pointed HOOD framing face with one teal repair patch, subtle lashes. Exposed ink belly/base, no robes hiding body.
stages: Uneasy wide side-looking eyes, lips pressed with one fang. Both hands carefully hold ONE stubby unlit crooked CANDLE in a little clay saucer.
Ecstatic eyes up, broad crooked underbite smile. Same hood/patch; same candle now lit with SMALL solid clay flame, plain dark brass saucer; one twisted cord collar.

Chilly serene half-lidded eyes, tight smug single-fang smirk. Same small hood with modest copper edging; same candle now THREE fat fused stubs in ONE compact brass saucer, no flames near face, no cult scene.
rows.note: Die letzte Wahrheit wurde ihr zunächst probeweise übertragen.

rows.name: Diakonin Nebenwirkung
rows.signature: broad upright bell-shaped goo blob with little curled crown emerging beside tiny ivory linen cap, short pale-blue stole collar only, subtle lashes, ONE square upper tooth and a big lower fang. A thick brass spoon-shaped sun medallion is always at collar.
stages: Worried drooping mouth, wide eyes watching hands. One hand holds small wooden healing MALLET with linen-padded head, other cradles a plain bandage roll.
Sternly encouraging crooked teeth, one eyebrow raised. Same padded mallet now brass-capped, SAME bandage roll in little leather loop; cap/collar/medallion unchanged.
Beatific closed-lip self-satisfaction, half-lidded sideways gaze. Same compact mallet now beautiful rounded brass with ivory padding, one modest copper shoulder clasp, no mitre or full robe.
rows.note: Sie heilt grundsätzlich nur Beschwerden mit ordentlichem Formular.

rows.name: Herr Mitnahme
rows.signature: small diagonal bean-shaped goo splat, one hooked ink curl and low side nubs, ONE long upper buck tooth, tiny sage-green soft cap with mustard patch and narrow burgundy neckerchief, always a plump old key.
stages: Alarmed eyes glance back, puckered crooked worried lip. Holds one tiny bent iron KEY and a nearly flat worn purse.
Suspicious narrowed gaze to side, tight asymmetric closed tooth smile. Same green cap/patch and neckerchief; same key now on short brass ring with two other keys, purse slightly fuller.
Offended aristocratic squint, lower lip thrust forward. Same key ring now a splendid compact brass MASTER KEY and one matching little fat locked purse; not a huge treasure chest.
rows.note: Er bezeichnet Besitz als einen vorübergehenden Blickwinkel.

rows.name: Frau Schlussstrich
rows.signature: upright thin inverted-drop ink splat with one LOW coiled crown tuft, subtle long lids/lashes, TWO tiny offset lower teeth, short midnight-blue hood collar folded behind head and one small coral knot. No human ninja body.
